correctness.rationale: In exact arithmetic least-squares orthogonality and the reverse construction give precisely all feasible unit-vector pairs at each residual ratio t<=mu. A compressed SPD spectral bound reduces the relative error to a two-by-two determinant-one singular-value formula, attained via an explicit two-mode top singular vector. Differentiation yields the unique peak and the sharp nonexpansion crossing. The package checker independently evaluates 99 rational first-step identities and 27461 numerical witness/envelope cases; no finite enumeration is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A sharp condition-number-dependent inner tolerance separating guaranteed nonexpansion of physical solution error from genuine expansion is a natural quantitative stopping-rule decision for FGMRES. The attained full minimax profile and saturation in dimension two provide informative benchmarks distinct from known residual contraction. The exact statement is limited to first outer steps and arbitrary inner actions, not a specific inner algorithm or multistep convergence.
